ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 4:1 ratio of high-intensity white (pixel values ~200-245) to low-intensity black/dark grey (pixel values ~10-40) across visible ventral surfaces.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Broad white central field bounded by irregular dark peripheral margins. Left lobe displays a dense dark patch approximately 25% inward from the lateral tip. Right lobe features sparse dark punctate clusters on a dominant white field.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, non-uniform serration. Left lobe trailing edge exhibits deep, irregular concave notches (amplitudes >30 pixels). Right lobe exhibits more consistent, lower-amplitude triangular peaks (~5-10 pixels).
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Bilateral convex upward curvature tapering to acute lateral tips; right lobe displays a more pronounced upward sweep relative to the horizontal plane of the splash zone.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: High-contrast white pixel clusters consistent with sessile organism attachment are localized at the extreme lateral tip of the right lobe and scattered along the left lobe trailing edge peaks.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Set of four distinct, parallel dark linear streaks oriented diagonally (approx. 45-degree angle) on the upper-inner quadrant of the right lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Deep irregular indentations and tissue loss on the trailing edge of the left lobe, creating a ragged, non-linear profile compared to the right lobe.
other_distinctive_markers: A prominent dark 'X' shaped pigmentation mark located in the upper-right region of the right lobe ventral surface.
